title: Crisp Venezuelan Empanadas with Garlic
description: A delicious twist on traditional empanadas, filled with a zesty garlic filling and fried to a crispy perfection.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of the garlic filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Dredge the empanadas in a mixture of flour, salt, and pepper, shaking off excess.
Fry the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels.
Serve hot, garnished with crisp lettuce if desired.
